metrics.fps: Per-run frames / sampled time (1000 / mean interval between consecutive animation-frame callbacks); rendering-loop throughput, not screen-present FPS
metrics.frameP50: Per-run 50th percentile of the same frame intervals, milliseconds
metrics.frameP95: Per-run 95th percentile of the same frame intervals, milliseconds
metrics.cpuMemoryMiB: Sum of main + live Worker JS heaps, main + Worker ArrayBuffer/external backing storage, and Worker WASM capacity, MiB; accounting sum, not deduplicated physical memory
metrics.gpuMiB: Explicit live GPU resource capacity excluding timing-query buffers, MiB; not physical VRAM
metrics.workerP50: Native Worker sort execution, excluding message transfer, milliseconds
metrics.rpcP50: Sort Worker request-to-response time including message transfer, milliseconds
metrics.asyncP50: Native asynchronous sort completion; Radix includes GPU key projection/readback and Worker sort delivery, milliseconds
metrics.gpuSortP50: First-to-last native GPU radix pass span, milliseconds
metrics.memoryAggregation: Sum CPU components within each snapshot first, then take the maximum across sorted cases per run and median across three runs; GPU is aggregated separately
